result.rationale: The server schema (addGuests.schema.ts) is only `z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness refine; the handler's `uniqueGuests` filter only removes guests already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted ones — it never dedupes within the input array. So a direct API mutation with duplicate emails creates duplicate attendees and duplicate emails. Uniqueness is only enforced client-side in AddGuestsDialog.
